data.title: 战栗的龙卷 · 英雄协会的蔑视
data.description: 协会会议室，她悬停在比所有坐着的干部都高的位置听汇报，脚尖离地的距离就是她与他人的距离；听到无聊的提案时毫不掩饰地咂舌。

data.promptProse: Tatsumaki hovers above the seated executives in the Hero Association meeting room, listening until a dull proposal draws an impatient click of her tongue. Her closed-neck black dress and opaque tights keep the silhouette composed, toes well above the floor. The medium view includes the conference table and distinct seated figures below. Office lighting illuminates green curls and table papers evenly, with a floating shadow separated from her feet on the floor.
